personality_one_liner: A friendly, welcoming, and tactile experience that makes finding grocery deals feel rewarding and effortless.

spacing.rule: Use generous tactile padding. Cards shouldn't feel cramped.

do's: Use on sticky primary CTA button backgrounds at the bottom
dont's: Do not use on regular cards or list items
Do not use on form inputs

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Capture ZIP code and 2-4 preferred stores to personalize deals.
screens.layout: Large welcoming headline. ZIP code input with large touch target. A masonry or flex-wrap grid of store choice chips (brandTertiary bg when selected). Sticky CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Watchlist
screens.purpose: Allow users to add their regular grocery items to track price drops.

states.empty: Playful illustration of empty shopping basket + 'Add your first item' button.

screens.layout: Single column list of cards. Each card shows item name, size, and usual price. A sticky FAB for 'Add Item' (barcode scan or manual type).

screens.name: Deals Feed (Home)
screens.purpose: Showcase deals scored 10%+ off or BOGO, grouped by store.

states.empty: Playful illustration 'No deals today, check back tomorrow!'

screens.layout: Pinterest-style 2-column masonry grid for deal cards. Each card has an image, bright discount badge (brand primary), product name, and store logo/initials. Filter tabs at the top for stores.

screens.name: Savings Summary
screens.purpose: Highlight total potential savings this week with a large hero number.

states.empty: Start adding to your watchlist to see savings.

screens.layout: Large hero typography for '$X Weekly Savings'. Confetti or playful background shapes. A 'Check deals now' sticky button.

empty_aisle.alt: Clean grocery store aisle for empty state

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Personality 4 (Tactile / Playful LIGHT). Elements should have soft rounding (radius lg to pill), and the UI should feel welcoming and touchable.
BANNED COLORS: Blue, Purple, Indigo. We are using an Emerald Green (`#059669`) as the primary brand color to represent fresh savings and money.

For store logos (Kroger, Target, H-E-B) where we couldn't fetch real PNGs, use the initial fallback pattern: a circle with the brandTertiary background and the first letter of the store in the center.
Implement a Pinterest-style 2-column masonry grid for the Deals Feed. Deal cards should emphasize the discount badge.
Make the Savings Summary screen impactful with oversized typography for the total savings number.
Use sticky buttons (e.g., 'Check deals now') at the bottom of scrollable screens, housed in a glassmorphism container if over scrolling content.
Typography: Use Plus Jakarta Sans exclusively, capped at 500 weight. Use size to establish hierarchy instead of bold weights.
Haptics: Add subtle haptics to the '+' add button in the Watchlist and when toggling store chips in onboarding.
